title: Variance from Hermite coefficients
statement:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\gamma_n$ be the product of $n$ standard Gaussian probability measures on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^2(\gamma_n)$. For each multi-index $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$, let $c_\alpha$ be the integral of $f$ against the corresponding normalized multivariate Hermite polynomial. Then
\[
\operatorname{Var}_{\gamma_n}(f)=\sum_{\alpha\in\mathbb N^n,\,\alpha\ne0}c_\alpha^2.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb R^n$
